notes.notes:
Adjusted the final puzzle of Museum to feel better when attaching the artifact to the helicopter 
 Adjusted lighting in some darker areas that made the eye icons for Eye Spy achievement difficult to find

notes.title: 17/11/2021 Human Fall Flat Hotfix
notes.notes:
"Hello, Humans!

We've just updated Human: Fall Flat with the November Hotfix which fixes a number of recent issues, namely the problems that Mac users and Workshop creators were encountering.

Once you download this update, Mac users will be able to boot the game without any issue. On top of that, you'll once again be able to find the important Workshop package in your Human: Fall Flat folder.

As well as all that, we've updated the visuals in the Lumber level, so certain assets that were disappearing on the lowest shadow quality will no longer vanish, and fog will appear as it should. And there was a symbol in the simplified & traditional Chinese name for Lumber that wasn't appearing correctly, but has now been fixed.

We apologise for any inconvenience this caused. Thanks very much for your patience."

notes.title: Lunar Update
notes.notes:
***Celebrate Lunar New Year in the lobby now!***

Lunar New Year celebrations are in full swing across China. Join the fun in a wonderful new feature packed lobby. Explore seven areas inspired by traditional Chinese tales. Unite the 12 zodiac symbols, shake the Fortune Tree to be richly rewarded and ride the Fortune Carp rollercoaster as it transforms into a dragon. Could the sky palace be your final destination? Jump in with up to seven other friends to see in the Chinese New Year together!

With a staggering combined audience of over 220M followers, Xiao Tuantuan, Daimei, Sanren, Zrdxr and LanZhanFei are some of the most popular content creators in China and with this update players will receive five in-game skins based on their likeness. 

In addition, Chinese composer Moyun has contributed her beloved music composition Dreaming of the Prosper Era to the Lunar Lobby, while musician Xu Mengyuan's track China-P features in the Lunar Lobby official launch trailer.

notes.title: Brand new FREE level 'Steam' available now! (plus some patch notes)
notes.notes:
Howdy, Humans!

We have some exciting news to share today...

There's a brand new FREE Human: level available right now on PC. Hooray!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25421434/df8f979340a4cd2ea6091aeaf227b733425a5039.jpg

This brand-new core level is set in a steam-powered industrial environment, where new puzzles and mechanics revolve around making the abundant amounts of water vapour work for you.

Start an industrial revolution, manipulate barrels, pipes, furnaces and more to make your way to the exit, and have your friends join you to play in two-player local co-op or up to eight-player online multiplayer.

Download 'Steam' today and let us know what you think!

Watch the full trailer now:
https://youtu.be/Lrp06smVBDk

Patches
And on top of the new level, we've worked in some fixes as well.
Check out the patch notes below:
Minor Feature Additions
Prefabs – With the update to v1045609 we've also included an updated Human Unity package (Version 1.2) that adds the “Steam” level Prefab set and the “Steam” level Prefab Testbed.
Bug Fixes
Multiplayer – Players will no longer have their game crash upon loading into a multiplayer game if the last workshop lobby that user used was unstable.

notes.title: Win $10,000 in the Worldwide Human: Fall Flat Workshop Competition – plus patch update 1.1

Since official Steam Workshop support for Human: Fall Flat launched back in April, we’ve been blown away by the incredible new levels you’ve been creating via Unity. In fact, some of them are so darn good; we think they’re worthy of a little recognition.

To say thank-you for all your hard work so far, today we’re launching…

 The Human: Fall Flat Workshop Competition

Full name
Steam username
A URL to your newly-created level on Steam

Once chosen by Curve Digital, the creator of the winning level will see their design make its way into Human: Fall Flat and will be published alongside our OFFICIAL levels – as well as receive $10,000 for their trouble.

-The Human: Fall Flat Team

Fixed minor graphical issues seen throughout the “Dark” level including misplaced polygons, flickering and incorrect textures.


Bob'ly yours, 

Tomas Sakalauskas & Curve Digital

notes.title: Human: Fall Flat gets a holiday update, with unlockable skins!
notes.notes:
The holidays are here!

No Brakes Games, creators of Human: Fall Flat, alongside award-winning publisher Curve Digital, today announces that a new multiplayer lobby will be added to Human: Fall Flat which will allow players to unlock skins in exchange for returning presents. Following the hugely successful launch of Human: Fall Flat’s multiplayer mode, now players will get the holiday experience brought to them through the eyes of Bob and his holiday extravaganza!

“Bob loves going on adventures,” says George Morgan, Product Manager for Curve Digital, “and with the holiday season on our doorstep, we thought the Bob deserved the best holiday ever! Starting today, a new multiplayer lobby will be live which features The Totalizer, a bar that rises when players place presents on the conveyor belt. The more presents, the more skins that will unlock for all players! When it reaches the top, a surprise awaits, and it could be one of the most requested things in Human: Fall Flat history.”

notes.title: Thursday multiplayer update: Hit the deck for Aztec
notes.notes:
Hello Humans,
 
The moment we’ve all been waiting for has finally come – multiplayer beta testers can now play the entire game online with their friends.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25421434/2643d2aca6b393164bc15c0c92907c02545b9eb8.png

Yep, from the opening to the Aztec, all of Human: Fall Flat is unlocked for online multiplayer. We’re going to leave this build with you guys for a few weeks before we push the mode public, so please do continue to try to play the game in as many unexpected ways as possible.
 
A couple of other tweaks to tell you about:

 Holding TAB in multiplayer will now show you the player names
 Reload checkpoint in the pause menu is enabled for clients, respawning only their characters
  Added “lock level” option in the lobby settings to prevent someone accidentally progressing to the next level

We’ve also added some new chat commands:

  / list – displays a list of players in the game
  / mute – N – mutes/unmutes the player with number N
  / kick N – kicks the player (only works if you’re the host)

I do hope you enjoy. Once we’ve ironed out any subsequent issues, we’ll be pushing this to public BETA and then to the full release, so expect more and more Humans to be online over the coming weeks.

Next for us? Well, now we’ve figured out online multiplayer, we’re looking at ways of giving you more content. Oh, and a Festive treat, too.
 
Until next time,
 
Tomas Sakalauskas

###
How to access the multiplayer mode beta
• Open Steam
• Highlight Human: Fall Flat in your library
• Right-click and select “Properties”
• Hit the “Betas” tab
• Enter the code: “OnlineMultiplayer” into the black box and select “check code”
• Select the Multiplayer beta from the drop-down menu
• Your game should now automatically update
• Enjoy!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25421434/a5ee8c9d2beba5cc09ac510c9c2803e7a8632a73.gif

notes.title: Thursday multiplayer update: You’ve got the power (plant)
notes.notes:
Hello Humans, and welcome to this week’s multiplayer update - which today unlocks the Power Plant level.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25421434/4736a5a6ebd2a2896d55077fd4938627496f351c.png
 
A couple of wider updates debut in this build – we’ve enabled the in-game shell, which can be accessed by hitting ` (top left key). Feel free to tinker with the commands, which can be viewed by typing "?" [enter]. As ever, have fun with this build – but do expect the occasional issue. We’re aiming for full, public release of online multiplayer towards the end of this month.
 
Enjoy!
 
Tomas Sakalauskas

notes.title: Water load of fun - here's today's new multiplayer update
notes.notes:
Hello Humans!
 
Thank you so much for being part of our online journey as we head towards a full public release of Human: Fall Flat multiplayer.
 
So far we’ve seen Bob wobble across land, fly through air in a catapult – and now it’s time to take to the sea, as we unlock the water level for you to try in online multiplayer.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25421434/019144d39d1315745de21a5c5995e16995c30176.png
 
This update also brings with it a couple of fixes – if you’re hosting, you should find things a little less jittery, and we’ve nerfed an issue where certain combinations of players would break the server. We’ve also made it clearer how to start the co-op experience. As ever, thanks for all of your feedback.
 
We’re enormously grateful for your help and patience as we gradually work towards the full public release. If you’ve not yet opted into the beta, complete instructions are below – please see recent updates for caveats 

tl;dr. – We’re unlocking things bit by bit, and there will inevitably be things which are broken).
 
But enough from me this week. It’s time to dive in.
 
Yours,
 
Tomas Sakalauskas

notes.notes:
Hello Friends!
We are super-duper-pleased to announce that our free content update for Human: Fall Flat is live right now on Steam. This update brings you a new level to enjoy, costumes to play around with and new achievements to challenge you. Check out our new trailer to see everything in action or read on below.

Aztec Level – Explore a mysterious temple, evade the traps and see what secrets you can uncover.   Our new dreamscape will test all the skills you’ve acquired during your adventures so far.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25421434/084afb04a781e3b8d5748dae1c911a2483101b5d.png

Costumes  – Want to dress like a builder in the demolition level? You go for it! How about a police officer? Or maybe a hazmat suit? Perhaps you just want to explore in the comfort of a nice hoodie? Enjoy the new character skins and make them your own by mixing them together or changing the colours.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25421434/a6e64af1d781dc9fd22356254de65cb0e37fd6f1.jpg

Achievements  – The Aztec level brings with it some new achievements for the Human: Fall Flat pros out there. We reckon they’re going to test your skills. If you manage to get them all please do share screenshots of your victories in the forum and reap the glory.

Have fun everyone,

No Brakes Games & Curve Digital

notes.title: 1.2 Alpha2: Huge Customization and Workshop Update
notes.notes:
Hello fellow humans,

Over the last weeks, I’ve been spending time helping creators with the Alpha Workshop and also rewriting character customization based on feedback received so far. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25421434/e5d6748137e3c84f4d30cd65d32e3d4696159988.jpg
Sneak peek screenshot of the upcoming customization. 

Here’s the kinds of things I’ve been hearing:

“I want to customise my co-op partner”

“How do I lose the hat? I hate health and safety.”

“Can I have a wardrobe to swap and change my custom designs (just like Cher) as I wish?”

“I saw this really cool skin, how do I get it?” 

And finally, “What the hell is a mask?”

By taking into account all of these requests (and many others of a similar nature), I’ve devised the following features to be implemented in the customisation menu in the next update:

Undo/redo for painting – Did that last paint stroke ruined your beautiful creation? Undo it and go for the perfect take.

Simple masking – Just like masking tape. Select the parts you want to paint and just paint till your heart’s content. Each piece of clothing has its own pre-set masks, like the main colour, secondary colour, etc.

Simplified webcam process – Select the parts that you want to be textured with a webcam, press “TAKE PHOTO” and then smile (if you want to) while the timer counts down. Fully integrated to painting and includes undo & redo.

Improved UV unwrapping – UV unwrapping is how the game maps a 2D object (eg. your face on the webcam) onto a 3D surface (Bob). The changes to this will help increase the precision for different textures especially around the face region.

Got no painting skills at all? – Just pick primary/secondary/tertiary colours for different parts of the character and you’ve got your own unique look.

Co-Op buddy - Customize both the main and co-op character independently of each other to create your very own dream team.

Skin presets – Save as many skins as you like and use them when you like.

Wardrobe – Mix and match clothing designs for the head, upper body and lower body to build your own custom character.

Controller support - New customize has full controller support, except the manual painting where mouse is the only viable option.

Skin workshop – Publish your fabulous creations for others to enjoy and subscribe to skins others have created.

Custom mesh – Is Bob’s hard hat bringing you down? Use custom mesh to replace it or even the whole character. Create your own model or use an existing mesh of matching proportions and the game will automatically rig it to the character bones. Upload your models to the workshop allowing everyone to use them in their creations.

More workshop

There are additional feature to level workshop as well. Over the coming weeks I will make some video guides on using the workshop to create your own levels. Here's a quick summary:

 Wall volume editor - no more struggling with unity cubes trying to create level structure. It's as easy as playing Minecraft. 
 Mansion level prop library - now you can use some assets from the actual game. Like trees, columns, some of the ground pieces, etc. Eventually each of the levels will be decomposed into reusable assets and exposed for you to use.
 Sound engine redesign - this was neccessary to allow authoring of audio fx, ambience and music for your levels. Alpha2 has a preview of the new sound engine and several sounds from the mansion level compiled as a reusable library. Combining the sound engine with the signals will serve as a base for the mechanical components (like elevators) that will be exposed in the next Alpha.
 Unlimited amount of subscribed levels,
 Full controller support for workshop functionality.


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25421434/0c471f06779006d27cd3586268c85e651e08eb63.jpg

Optimizaiton
This build includes all the optimizations which were done for the upcoming console version. The last levels were quite heavy on CPU, which is now reduced to 25-50% of what it used to be.

Be sure to check out the Alpha2 release on the modders branch of the game as described in this guide and stay tuned for video tutorials.

Looking forward to your new, beatiful levels and your feedback!

Have fun,

Tomas

notes.title: Human: Fall Flat – Theater Mode update! Play in first-person view!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Humans 
We’ve *loved* seeing videos of your adventures within the Human: Fall Flat dreamscapes – it’s been absolutely hysterical seeing the ways in which you’ve been solving puzzles and having fun. 
 
Whilst there’s a lot of Human: Fall Flat work going on in the background, we wanted to issue a small update which fixes a few things based on your feedback
 Checkpoints! 
But also introduces a brand new Theater Mode. 
 
 Theater Mode 
The Theater Mode is a slightly refined version of the development workarounds we used to record gameplay footage. It offers you much greater control over camera angles, timings, etc. which will enable you to create your own mini masterpieces starring Bob. Want to focus some more on specific details of the custom skins you’ve been creating? Position the camera wherever you like and show off your artistry to the world. 
 
 First Person Mode 
Also now available is the new First-person Mode. Highly experimental but utterly ridiculous, this new camera option will enable you to see the world through Bob’s eyes. It's a debug feature rather than a new game mode, but we figured you'd like to have fun with it. 
 
 Jump to checkpoint 
We’ve also enabled some additional options which will help you jump to specific parts of the game. 

These are all offered as experimental features. Aside from halting achievements once enabled (which can be reenabled by returning to the menu screen and starting the level again), they may cause the game to behave in unexpected ways. 
 
Full instructions for these new options are available on the community page.
 
Thanks again for playing the game - it's been a wild ride, and this is only the beginning. Keep an eye out for future updates (we are looking into Workshop support). But in the meantime, please do send us your videos @HumanFallFlat
 
Specific changes AKA tldr:

    Theater Mode
    First-person Mode
    Checkpoint Improvement


Edit:
For those of you looking for the instruction on how to use these modes, please follow this link to the instructions
